body.text: Confirming interface for greet.greet(name) before I write test_greet.py: does it (1) strip surrounding whitespace and return e.g. 'Hello, Alice!' for a normal name, (2) raise ValueError for empty string or whitespace-only name, and (3) is the return format exactly 'Hello, {name}!'? Also should test_greet.py do 'from greet import greet' or 'import greet'? My proposed terms are in terms-b.json (inputs: greet.py, outputs: test_greet.py, acceptance: python3 -m unittest -v).
